name: setasign/fpdi
input_api: Fpdi::setSourceFile(local PDF path), importPage(1), getTemplateSize(); page count and dimensions
scope: One PDF page, 216 × 279 mm rounded imported MediaBox
family: FPDI native PHP PDF object reader
family_note: FPDI reads and imports the PDF page using its own parser; setasign/fpdf 1.9.0 is a required rendering companion, not a separate PDF reader.

name: smalot/pdfparser
input_api: Parser::parseFile(local PDF path); page count and extracted text
scope: One PDF page and embedded Parsarium text
family_note: Own PHP PDF object and content stream parser.

name: spatie/pdf-to-text
scope: Embedded Parsarium text extracted from PDF
family_note: PHP wrapper invokes local pdftotext 26.11.0; shared native backend is recorded.

name: mikehaertl/php-pdftk
input_api: Pdf(local PDF path)->getData(); parsed page count and Title metadata
scope: One PDF page and document title
family_note: PHP wrapper invokes pinned local pdftk-java 3.3.3; the native PDF reader is shared with other pdftk wrappers.

name: propa/tcpdi
input_api: TCPDI::setSourceFile(local PDF path), importPage(1), getTemplateSize(); page count and dimensions
scope: One PDF page, 216 × 279 mm rounded imported MediaBox
family_note: TCPDI is a separately maintained FPDI-derived import implementation bundled with its own tcpdi_parser; TCPDF is the rendering companion.

name: iio/libmergepdf
input_api: Merger::addFile(local PDF path), merge(); imported page object in emitted PDF
scope: One imported PDF page object in emitted PDF
family: FPDI native PHP PDF object reader
family_note: Merger wrapper delegates PDF import to pinned FPDI 2.6.10; shared parser family with setasign/fpdi, counted as a separate Composer package path.

name: magento/zend-pdf
input_api: Zend_Pdf::load(local PDF path); parsed pages and Title metadata
scope: One PDF page and document title
family_note: Magento package contains the Zend Framework PDF object reader; its own local file load method parses page and document metadata.

name: webklex/laravel-pdfmerger
input_api: PDFMerger::addPDF(local PDF path, page 1), merge(), output(); one imported PDF page object
scope: One imported page object in emitted PDF
family: FPDI native PHP PDF object reader
family_note: Laravel-oriented wrapper delegates page import to pinned FPDI 2.6.10; illuminate/filesystem 13.42.0 is an explicit companion dependency.

name: jurosh/pdf-merge
input_api: PDFMerger::addPDF(local PDF path), merge(string); one imported PDF page object
scope: One imported page object in emitted PDF
family: FPDI native PHP PDF object reader
family_note: Wrapper delegates page import to pinned FPDI 2.6.10. Composer metadata says MIT, but the pinned LICENSE file and README specify Apache-2.0.

name: karriere/pdf-merge
input_api: PdfMerge::add(local PDF path), merge(string); one imported PDF page object
scope: One imported page object in emitted PDF
family_note: Wrapper bundles a TCPDI parser derived from FPDI and uses pinned TCPDF 6.11.4 as rendering companion.
